name: MongoDB
description: Connector for MongoDB / MongoDB Atlas. Batch + CDC source (pymongo / Debezium change streams) AND destination (import/upsert/delete keyed on _id; collections auto-create, no DDL).

supported_versions.batch: MongoDB 4.4 and later; MongoDB Atlas (all tiers). pymongo 4.x driver.
supported_versions.cdc: MongoDB 4.4+ / Atlas via Debezium change streams — requires a replica set or sharded cluster (a standalone mongod cannot emit change streams). capture.mode=change_streams_update_full so every update carries a full post-image.
supported_versions.destination: Any writable MongoDB / Atlas deployment. Idempotent upsert/delete keyed on _id (or a relational source's key_fields); collections auto-create on first write.

supported_auth_methods.description: MongoDB username/password (SCRAM) authentication. Omit for an unauthenticated deployment.

host.description: MongoDB host (e.g. mongo.internal or cluster0.abcd.mongodb.net). Ignored when connection_string is set.

port.description: MongoDB port (default 27017). Ignored for mongodb+srv:// / connection_string.

database.description: Database name whose collections are discovered/captured.

user.description: MongoDB username (SCRAM). Optional for an unauthenticated deployment.

replica_set.description: Replica set name (e.g. rs0). Required for CDC unless connection_string encodes it. Enables replica-set topology discovery.

connection_string.description: Full MongoDB URI (mongodb:// or mongodb+srv://). Wins over discrete fields — required for Atlas SRV.

tls.description: TLS mode: 'true'/'require' to force TLS. Auto-on for *.mongodb.net (Atlas).

connection_string.description: Full MongoDB URI (wins over discrete fields)

operations.name: discover_schema
operations.description: Discover collections and their sampled fields

parameters.name: max_tables
parameters.description: Maximum number of collections to return

parameters.name: sample_size
parameters.description: Documents sampled per collection to infer fields

operations.name: get_capabilities
operations.description: Return connector capabilities for agent interaction

operations.name: get_primary_key
operations.description: Return the primary key (_id) for a collection

operations.name: export
operations.description: Export documents from a collection (_id keyset paging)

operations.name: import_data
operations.description: Insert documents into a collection (batch / CDC insert). upsert_data and delete_data are advertised at runtime via get_capabilities for the CDC update/delete paths.

parameters.name: key_fields
parameters.description: Write key column(s); defaults to _id. A relational source passes its own primary key here.
